title: NEXT F Commerce Domain Error Identifiers
description: Stable Phase 12 domain errors. HTTP mappings are reserved for Phase 18.

errors.label: Commerce rule violation
errors.description: A canonical Commerce Rule was not satisfied.

errors.label: Commerce state conflict
errors.description: Authoritative state changed or a protected mutation conflicts with current state.

errors.label: Checkout requires revalidation
errors.description: Checkout source state is stale and must be recalculated/revalidated.

errors.label: Invalid lifecycle transition
errors.description: Requested state transition is not allowed by the canonical state machine.

errors.label: Already converted
errors.description: A Cart/Checkout conversion was already completed and cannot create another canonical result.

errors.label: Order not cancellable
errors.description: Current Order state/policy does not allow cancellation.

errors.label: Order not completable
errors.description: Required completion conditions are not satisfied.

errors.label: Commerce total mismatch
errors.description: Submitted or calculated monetary components do not reconcile.

errors.label: Currency mismatch
errors.description: Monetary records do not use the required transaction currency.

errors.label: Price changed
errors.description: Authoritative price no longer matches the stale transaction selection.

errors.label: Product unavailable
errors.description: Product or Variant is not currently eligible for purchase.

errors.label: Insufficient inventory
errors.description: Available stock/backorder policy does not permit the requested quantity.

errors.label: Inventory reservation is terminal
errors.description: Reservation has already been committed/released/expired/cancelled or cannot be reactivated.

errors.label: Inventory conflict
errors.description: Concurrent or inconsistent inventory mutation prevents safe commit.

errors.label: Capture exceeds authorization
errors.description: Capture amount exceeds the valid remaining authorization/capturable bound.

errors.label: Authorization unavailable
errors.description: Authorization is expired, voided, insufficient or otherwise not valid for capture.

errors.label: Payment reference conflict
errors.description: External/provider financial reference is already bound to another accepted fact.

errors.label: Refund exceeds captured amount
errors.description: Requested cumulative refund exceeds successfully captured refundable funds.

errors.label: Refund quantity exceeded
errors.description: Refunded quantity exceeds eligible purchased quantity.

errors.label: Fulfillment quantity exceeded
errors.description: Fulfillment quantity exceeds remaining eligible ordered quantity.

errors.label: Discount ineligible
errors.description: Promotion/coupon no longer satisfies eligibility or stacking requirements.

errors.label: Discount usage exhausted
errors.description: Coupon/promotion usage limit has been reached.

errors.label: Tax unresolved
errors.description: Required tax jurisdiction/basis/rate could not be safely resolved.

errors.label: Shipping unavailable
errors.description: No eligible shipping method/rate can satisfy the checkout selection.

errors.label: Return ineligible
errors.description: Order/line is outside the permitted return policy or eligibility rules.

errors.label: Return quantity exceeded
errors.description: Requested cumulative return quantity exceeds eligible purchased quantity.

errors.label: Idempotency conflict
errors.description: The idempotency key was reused with materially different canonical input.

errors.label: Provider reconciliation required
errors.description: External provider evidence conflicts with or cannot safely determine canonical state.

errors.label: Commerce permission required
errors.description: Actor lacks the required canonical commerce permission.

errors.label: Commerce tenant scope violation
errors.description: Operation crosses or cannot prove the required Organization/Site boundary.
